verdict.rationale: Lambda documents a REST API with a published OpenAPI spec (cloud.lambda.ai/api/v1/openapi.json) enabling programmatic instance management, which is a foundation for building integrations, but there is no evidence of official language SDKs (Python, JS, Go, etc.) — only raw REST endpoints and cloud-init hooks. The only agent-friendly tooling found is a third-party/unofficial CLI+MCP server, not a first-party SDK. missing for 10: official SDK libraries/language bindings, first-party agent/MCP tooling, llms.txt or machine-readable docs (404s confirmed).
